cases._note: Everything in OR 3 that participates in setting up. The door is not touched: preparation is not access control.

The interesting case, and the reason this domain is in the corpus. The ward display is NOT included though it can show a warning — waking patients for an alert meant for staff is harm. And the OR door is not unlocked: in a plant, egress; in a sterile field, contamination. Same intent, opposite answers.

prepare_operating_room.description: Prepare an operating room for a procedure

_note_intent_classes: Declared here so the benchmark registers them before evaluating. Without this the tool could only measure the five universal intents, which is why every published evaluation of this project covered one domain.
